title: Think in Safety: Unveiling and Mitigating Safety Alignment Collapse in Multimodal Large Reasoning Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as specific categories within broader multimodal safety benchmarks (such as MM-SafetyBench, SIUO, and the authors' custom TiS dataset), measuring the model's Attack Success Rate (ASR) and safety-awareness scores when presented with text and image prompts designed to elicit discriminatory or hateful content.

Evaluated under the category of 'Political sensitivity' within the multimodal safety alignment datasets, assessing whether the model can properly identify and refuse unsafe or politically inappropriate multimodal requests.
